g.text: Distribution of input and output tokens per request — Azure LLM inference traces, 2023

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: how input and output token counts are distributed across 28,185 observed Azure inference requests. Left

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: panel counts requests per token bin; right panel gives the cumulative share, so any percentile reads off the curve.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Microsoft Azure, AzurePublicDataset — LLM inference production traces (2023 release, CC-BY) —

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: §3.2 — What we measured; §7.9 — De-duplication rule 3, sub-types

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Observation window — conversation 16 Nov 2023, 18:15–19:14; code 16 Nov 2023, 18:17–19:14. A 58-minute snapshot, not a representative

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: period, and it predates reasoning models and agentic tool-calling, both of which lengthen output. The code service's median input of

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: 1,469 tokens against a median output of 13 is the signature of inline completion, not chat. The horizontal axis is log-scaled because

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: token counts span several orders of magnitude and a linear axis would collapse everything below a thousand tokens into a single bar;

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: bins are left-closed powers of two. No request is excluded and the full long tail is drawn.
